input_kind.description: Input interpretation, e.g. close_price or simple_return. No automatic conversion.

weight.description: Signed linear exposure / positive portfolio equity, in a common currency.

start_ms.description: Half-open label interval [start,end); labels must be mature before fitting.

available_at_ms.description: All parameters and data in this task were available at this time.

returns.description: Simple total returns in asset order; common currency and period.

y.description: Aligned second series. Pair operations require y on every selected row.

rows.description: First value is the target for regressions, all columns are features for PCA.

oneOf.description: Points contain period excess returns, without annualization.
Points contain loss_1 - loss_2; positive means model 2 is better.
Aligned period scores/returns; columns are candidates, higher is better.
Aligned benchmark loss minus candidate loss; positive is better.

shocks.description: Full vector of price shocks in asset order. No inferred missing shocks.

sharpe_mean.description: Mean and sample standard deviation of unannualized trial Sharpe ratios.
